explanation: More built it from Greek ou, not, and topos, place, so Utopia is literally nowhere. It also puns on eu-topos, a good place.

claims.text: Thomas More coined the word Utopia for the imaginary island in his book Utopia, published in 1516.
Arcadia, Atlantis and Shangri-La were not coined by Thomas More: Arcadia is an ancient Greek region, Atlantis comes from Plato and Shangri-La from James Hilton's 1933 novel.
Utopia is formed from Greek ou (not) and topos (place).
The name also puns on Greek eu-topos, 'good place'.
